focus: Explain scaled dot-product attention with editable small Q, K, V matrices and a scaling toggle. Display scores, row-normalized weights, and weighted values. Explore equal scores and one dominant score; verify each weight row sums to one.
audience: Engineering undergraduate familiar with matrix multiplication
excerpt: Practice paraphrase of Attention Is All You Need, Section 3.2.1: Attention(Q,K,V) = softmax(Q K^T / sqrt(d_k)) V. Q contains queries, K contains keys of dimension d_k, and V contains values. The dot products measure query-key compatibility, division by sqrt(d_k) scales them, and softmax gives weights applied to the values. Softmax is applied independently across each query's key scores.
source_note: Practice paraphrase, not a verbatim quotation; use the actual supplied excerpt for assessment.
